business_problem: ADNOC needed a faster, more connected way to monitor, analyze, and manage drilling operations across its onshore and offshore rig fleet. Multiple tools and analysis cycles that took days limited engineering capacity and delayed identification of operational issues.
solution_summary: ADNOC's AI-enabled Real-Time Operations Center (RTOC) brings live rig data from onshore and offshore drilling operations into one environment, replacing multiple monitoring tools. Enabled by SLB's DrillOps™ intelligent well delivery and insights solutions, the platform combines operational data, advanced analytics, and AI-driven performance insights to help engineers monitor, analyze, and manage activity across more than 120 rigs. Automated dashboards present actionable information to business, asset, and drilling teams, while real-time analysis helps surface potential issues earlier. RTOC runs in ADNOC's cloud environment, with critical operational data and workflows kept within the UAE and securely stored in a UAE data centre. This setup gives teams a real-time view of rig activity while maintaining control of sensitive information under UAE jurisdiction.
